offer.title: Early Bird Offer
offer.body: Launch prices for early customers. Pay once, use for the whole period, on your phone and on the web.

current.title: Your license
current.trialTitle: You are on the free trial
current.trialBody_one: {{count}} day left. Everything works, so try it on real bills. Choose a plan any time before it ends and no days are lost.
current.trialBody_other: {{count}} days left. Everything works, so try it on real bills. Choose a plan any time before it ends and no days are lost.
current.expiredTrial: Your free trial ended on {{date}}. Your data is safe and you can view, print and export it. Choose a plan to start billing again.
current.expiredPaid: Your plan ended on {{date}}. Your data is safe and you can view, print and export it. Renew to start billing again.
current.extendNote: Buying another plan adds its time after your current end date. No days are lost.
current.platformBlocked: Your {{plan}} plan covers {{covers}} until {{date}}. A plan bought separately starts after that date. To use {{blocked}} now, upgrade below and pay only the difference.

plan.saves: Save {{amount}} compared with buying the 1 Year plan {{years}} times
plan.businessesUpTo: Up to {{n}} businesses on one plan

offline.title: Works offline
offline.body: Keep billing when the internet drops. Everything is saved on your device and sent when you are back online.

devices.title: Mobile + Web, one plan
devices.body: Use it as a website and install it on your phone. One plan covers both.

support.title: Constant customer support
support.body: Call or WhatsApp us any time you are stuck. The number is always in the sidebar.

updates.title: Regular updates
updates.body: New features and fixes reach the website for you automatically. No reinstalling.

gst.title: GST-ready invoices
gst.body: Tax invoices, challans and bills of supply with CGST, SGST and IGST worked out for you.

language.title: English and Hindi
language.body: Use the screen and print your invoices in either language.

safe.title: Your data stays yours
safe.body: Backed up on our server, exportable to Excel any time, even after your plan ends.

fast.title: Built for the keyboard
fast.body: Make a bill in seconds with shortcuts, even on a busy counter.

rows.gstInvoices: GST invoices, challans and non-GST bills

history.title: Payment history
history.invoiceFailed: Could not download the invoice. Please try again.

pay.testBody: This is a practice payment that charges nothing. It exists only while the app is being built and is switched off on the live site.
pay.success: Payment received. Your plan is active until {{date}}.
pay.pending: We have your payment but could not confirm it yet. Do not pay again: it will be added automatically within a few minutes. If it is not, call support and quote reference {{ref}}.
pay.needInternet: Connect to the internet to pay.
pay.unavailable: Online payment is not available yet. Please call or WhatsApp us to buy a plan.
pay.failed: Payment was not completed. You have not been charged.
pay.scriptFailed: Could not open the payment window. Check your connection and try again.
pay.paidWithCredits: Done. Your credits paid for the plan, and it is active until {{date}}.

footer.help: Questions before you buy? Call or WhatsApp
footer.note: After your plan ends you can still view, print and export all your data.

toast.loadFailed: Could not load plans. Please try again.

upgrade.title: Upgrade to Mobile + Web
upgrade.body: Use the mobile app and computers with one plan. You pay only the difference for the {{days}} days left, and your end date stays {{date}}.
upgrade.maths: New plan for the days left {{price}} minus credit for your current plan {{credit}}.
upgrade.success: Upgraded. Your plan now covers the mobile app and computers.

MOBILE.title: Mobile
MOBILE.where: Mobile app (Android and iPhone). The website opens view-only.

DESKTOP.title: Desktop
DESKTOP.where: Web app on computers, in any browser. The mobile app opens view-only.

BOTH.title: Desktop + Mobile
BOTH.where: Mobile app and web app on computers, both fully working.

staff.title: This plan belongs to the owner
staff.body: The plan is managed by {{owner}}. If it ends, ask them to renew it.

credits.title: Use my referral credits
credits.note: Credits are taken off the price of a new plan or a renewal. They cannot be used on an upgrade.

refer.title: Refer a friend, earn {{percent}}%
refer.body: Share your code with a fellow shopkeeper. You earn credits every time they pay or renew.
refer.bodyCredits: You have {{amount}} in credits. Share your code to earn more.
